_help.backups: How many older copies of each save are kept beside the current one (0-5). If the newest copy is ever broken (the browser closed mid-write, a bug), the game loads the newest good copy instead. Each copy takes the same space as the save.
_help.storageAllowed: Files of game code that may still use the browser's storage directly instead of the saves module, each with why — e.g. { "file": "src/ui/online/session.ts", "why": "the room code for rejoining (rooms module, until F95)" }. check:framework lists every other file that does.
